Title: Option to expand the status bar across multiple lines

Description:
It would be very useful if the VS Code status bar (at the bottom) could support multiple lines. Currently, with many extensions installed, not all indicators are visible.

One solution could be to allow users to drag the bar with the mouse to increase its height, thus displaying two or more lines. This would make it possible to view more extensions at once, without having to navigate through menus or hover over them.
